name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
description: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, gradients, 1-line JPEG/PNG image decoding, and visual GUI driver with runtime hardware autoSetup, Sunton/Waveshare ESP32-S3 direct GPIO & expander detection, adaptive multi-point autoCalibrate, built-in LDR auto-dimming, RGB LED control, and TFT_eSPI_Button support for ESP32 CYD resistive & capacitive boards and ESP32-S3 parallel RGB capacitive touch boards.
